frequency_question: What proportion of highly contested, high-dollar regulatory rules issued by executive agencies successfully survive both mandatory administrative friction and preliminary judicial review to reach final, enforceable status within one year of initial proposal?
membership_rule: Includes economically significant rules ($>$ $100M impact) subject to intense stakeholder litigation and OIRA review. Excludes routine updates, uncontested technical rules, and guidance documents not requiring formal notice-and-comment rulemaking.
coverage_note: 10 prominent major contested rules examined; representing a broader class of hyper-litigated structural interventions.
known_gaps: Selection bias toward high-profile rules that attract litigation; lower-visibility rules face less structural friction.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act standards and judicial review baselines remain stable over this timeframe, though shifting judicial doctrines could alter success rates slightly.
